name: 网易大神
text:
#!name=网易大神
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule


[Rule]
DOMAIN, httpdns.music.163.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, httpdns.n.netease.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, httpdns-sdk.n.netease.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, httpdns.yunxindns.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, lofter.httpdns.c.163.com,REJECT
DOMAIN, music.httpdns.c.163.com,REJECT
IP-CIDR, 59.111.239.61/32, REJECT, no-resolve
IP-CIDR, 59.111.239.62/32, REJECT, no-resolve
IP-CIDR, 115.236.121.51/32, REJECT, no-resolve
IP-CIDR, 115.236.121.195/32, REJECT, no-resolve

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/god\.gameyw\.netease\.com\/v\d\/ad/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/god\.gameyw\.netease\.com\/v\d\/app\/static\/conf\/getByModuleNameList$/i then reject_dict(200)
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/app-conf\.ds\.163\.com\/v\d\/app\/base\/conf\/static\/start-config\?/i then response.json.delete("result.updateConfig[2].itemList[94].itemList[2]")
^https:\/\/god\.gameyw\.netease\.com\/v\d\/ad - reject

[Script]
网易大神去广告 = type=http-response, pattern=^https:\/\/app-conf\.ds\.163\.com\/v1\/app\/base\/conf\/static\/start-config\?os=ios, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/NetEaseGodlike/NetEaseGodlike_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true, timeout=10

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% god.gameyw.netease.com, app-conf.ds.163.com
